about: The lesson capability each subject island's lessons need before they can be published, and whether it exists. status: ready (lessons can be written and published now), prepared (the capability exists and the island is registered for authoring; its first lessons can be written), missing (a shared capability must be built first). Read by scripts/curriculum-queue.ts; counts and order come from the catalog, never from here.

databases.capability: sql, er-diagram, normalization, query-plan, transaction-timeline, driver-code, protocol-sequence, architecture-diagram

networks.capability: network-protocol (packets through the layers, message sequences, node tables; field, layer, table, subnet and delay exercises)
networks.note: CN-0 built the capability; CN-1 published CN01–CN05; later lessons publish in id order

systems-analysis.capability: model-diagram (UML, DFD, BPMN, state and sequence models, checked by structure)

information-systems.capability: case-analysis (scenario data, decision tables, KPI calculations checked by value)

ai-foundations.capability: python-code (Python-only program lessons; search, games, logic and probability on the shared traces)
ai-foundations.note: AIF-0 built the capability; AIF-1 published AIF01–AIF05, AIF-2 AIF06–AIF10, AIF-3 AIF11–AIF15, AIF-4 AIF16–AIF19, AIF-5 the capstone AIF20: the island is complete

machine-learning.capability: python-code + data-explorer (fixed datasets, metrics computed in the browser)

large-language-models.capability: python-code + token, sampling and prompt explorers on recorded outputs (T3)

ai-agents.capability: agent trace (tool calls and memory as fixed transcripts)

ui-design.capability: design-lab (color contrast exists as a standalone lab; visual hierarchy and grid)

web-foundations.capability: web-code (HTML, CSS and DOM in a sandboxed frame, checked by DOM queries)

responsive-design.capability: web-code + responsive simulator (the standalone lab exists)

linux-systems.capability: terminal (the /learn/linux-terminal engine as a lesson capability with per-lesson file systems and checked tasks)
linux-systems.note: engine exists; shell covers pwd, ls, cd, mkdir, touch, cat, cp, mv, rm, chmod, echo, whoami
